svg.title: Bank Rock
svg.desc: The approved Inter Black wordmark in black, with the selected blue outline rock and a round NFC inlay: a continuous metallic antenna and central silicon die beneath a glossy sparkling blue silicone cover. Every eight seconds the die wakes, a current pulse runs the antenna coil from the centre outward and back over the crossover bridge, four compact signal rings ripple out of the chip while a highlight sweeps the cover, and the rock sways gently on its base before settling. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
